newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline soft with U.S., Med arbs closed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline soft with U.S., Med arbs closed.

text.p: NWE gasoline was weaker on Tuesday and traders said that although NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures prices ended the day slightly firmer, prices in the U.S. Gulf had lost ground relative to the screen.
Demand in ARA was limited. Barges traded at $203 and $204 fob ARA and one player said he thought $202 had also been done.
Arbitrage oportunities to the U.S. as well as the Mediterranean were not considered attractive for the time being.
Cargoes were quiet although one dealer said he was offering Eurograde into northern Germany at $214 cif NWE.
